senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חָבַר 4)a mark of violence, wound, discoloring.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>מקום שאינו עושה ח׳</he> a spot on which no wound is made by burning (e.g. on the nail).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:1">Snh. XI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 85b:3">85ᵇ</cite>) <he>עד שיעשה בהן ח׳</he> unless by striking them he creates a wound; Y. ib. XI, beg. 30ᵃ <he>באיזו ח׳ כחַבּוּרַת שבת כח׳ נזקין</he> what wound is meant here? One the creating of which would be a Sabbath offence (discoloring), or one of the kind required for claiming damages?; Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 5 <he>מכה שיש בה ח׳</he> (in order to be punishable with death) it must be a beating which makes a wound (or a sore).
Sabb. 107ᵇ ח׳ שאינה חוזרת a permanent discoloring, Ib. מניין לח׳ שאינה וכ׳ whence is it proven that by ḥabburah a permanent (not a momentary) discoloring is meant?—
<cite ref="Ketubot 3b:2">Keth. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>עושה ח׳</he> he makes a wound (by tearing the hymen).
<cite ref="Ketubot 5b:9">Ib. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>מקלקל בח׳</he> destroying by making a hole, <he>מתקן בח׳</he> amending by &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חבּוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:4">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>; a. e.
